description: List (action list), create (action create, label optional; at most 4 live) or revoke (action revoke, target a token_id or all) the tokens that act as your hosted identity. A new token is shown once with its mcp_url. Revoke one you think leaked; revoking the one you use disconnects you. Give a token you hand to another agent or app a spend limit: credit_per_day, credit_per_call and expires_at on create, or action limit with target a token_id to replace one (omitted fields lift that limit). A limited token can spend only within it, and can only list tokens; list shows each token's limit and today's spend. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.

credit_per_call.description: create or limit: the most one paid call through the token may cost (its max_cost); omit for no per-call limit

credit_per_day.description: create or limit: the most credit the token may spend per UTC day; omit for no daily limit

expires_at.description: create or limit: Unix time the token stops working; omit for no end

label.description: create: a name for the token, up to 64 bytes

target.description: revoke: a token_id, or all; limit: a token_id

name: manage_tokens
title: Manage tokens
